project_name: Dead by Daylight Global Match Tracker
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / DARK ATMOSPHERIC FOG

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase text-stone-100 drop-shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(220,38,38,0.5)]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-wide uppercase text-red-500 border-b border-red-950/60 pb-2

layout_and_spacing.container_wrapper: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#07080C] text-stone-100 flex flex-col justify-between pb-24 shadow-2xl border-x border-red-950/30
layout_and_spacing.grid_killer_cards: grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 sm:gap-3 p-3 bg-[#0F111A]/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl border border-red-950/40
layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 max-w-md w-full z-50 bg-[#0A0C14]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-red-900/40 p-2 flex justify-around items-center shadow-[0_-5px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]

quick_logger.killer_portrait_grid: 4-column thumb-friendly cards with high-contrast killer portraits, red active aura ring, and character name badge
quick_logger.survivor_picker: Horizontal scrollable avatar selector with high-contrast active state
quick_logger.outcome_buttons: Large tactile touch targets: Escaped (Green), Sacrificed (Red), Bled Out (Orange), Killed/Mori (Purple)
quick_logger.advanced_stats_collapsible: Smooth slide accordion containing sliders/steppers for chase duration (seconds), protection hits count, safe unhooks count

authentication.type: Email + PIN code modal / full screen auth drawer
authentication.reset_flow: Emailed PIN reset simulation with interactive 4-digit OTP input box

personal_dashboard.widgets: Nemesis Killer card, Best Survivor card, Escape/Kill Rate Circular Gauge, Trend Chart (Recharts dark theme with blood-red line & ember dots)
personal_dashboard.match_history: Filterable list of trials with instant swipe/button delete action (`data-testid="delete-match-{id}"`)
personal_dashboard.per_killer_breakdown: Dense statistical table with escape rate bar indicators

global_leaderboards.rank_badges: Gold/Silver/Bronze ember badges for top 3 players

admin_controls.kill_switch: Toggle switch in header/settings to replace licensed portrait images with clean dark typography badges for legal safety tests

legal_disclaimer.footer: Persistent low-contrast fan disclaimer footer: 'Unofficial fan-made project. Dead by Daylight is a registered trademark of Behaviour Interactive Inc. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Behaviour Interactive.'

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always maintain mobile-first PWA responsiveness (centered container max-w-md or max-w-lg on desktop viewports).
Never use pure #000000 background; use tinted near-black #07080C with subtle red/ember radial gradients or grain texture overlay.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive buttons, tabs, outcome selectors, form inputs, and delete triggers.
Ensure killer and survivor selection has instant visual feedback (glowing red stroke, scale up micro-animation).
Keep trial logging under 10 seconds workflow with clear single-tap choices.
